retrievalProfile.description: A vertically symmetrical layout featuring mirrored circular vignettes with a central horizontal typographic band and warm, high-contrast photography.
triggerTerms: western display lettering with warm gradients

recipe.visualDefinition: A central horizontal band of bold, decorative display type separates two mirrored, circular photographic vignettes. The vignettes feature a stippled or halftone edge transition into a clean white background, creating a 'playing card' symmetry.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical reflection of circular photographic elements
Horizontal typographic anchor bisecting the composition
High-contrast warm photography against a stark white field
Curved secondary text following the arc of the vignettes
coreInvariants: The central horizontal typographic band must be the widest element.
The top and bottom photographic elements must be mirrored reflections of each other.
Vignette edges must use a textured, stippled transition rather than a smooth gradient.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two mirrored subjects contained within circular vignettes at the top and bottom thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, central decorative text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Vertical flow from the top vignette, through the central text, to the inverted bottom vignette.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left and right margins, emphasizing the central vertical column.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and shadows within the circular vignettes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm oranges, yellows, and reds in the photography and text fill.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central text and warm highlights, contrasted against deep black shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Western-style slab serif with decorative flourishes.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy vertical strokes with thin horizontal connectors
Internal gradient fill from yellow to red
Thick black outline with a secondary thin yellow stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: T and M characters feature elongated, decorative spurs
S has a deep, sweeping curve with sharp terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact decorative display type paired with a neutral, wide-tracked sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the western slab-serif skeleton and decorative spurs.
Appropriate for the clean, wide-tracked secondary arched text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a white square canvas with two mirrored circular vignettes. The top vignette contains a warm-toned photo of a person, and the bottom is a vertically flipped version of the same. The edges of the circles should have a grainy, stippled black texture fading into the white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, two-line decorative western-style title in the center horizontal gap. Use a yellow-to-red vertical gradient fill with a thick black outline. Add secondary sans-serif text arched above the top circle and inverted/arched below the bottom circle.

verificationChecks: Does the central text have a double outline and warm gradient?
Are the vignette edges stippled/textured rather than smooth?
Is the secondary text arched to follow the circular vignettes?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or catalog numbers

mustAchieve: Legible but highly decorative central type

postGenerationChecks: Verify the bottom image is a true vertical reflection of the top.
Ensure the central text block is the primary focal point.
Check that the stippled edges feel organic and retro.
Confirm the color palette is limited to warm tones, black, and white.
